Obsidian pricing

Obsidian is free for personal use, with no account required and no limits on notes or vaults.

Sync is an optional add-on that keeps vaults up to date across devices with end-to-end encryption. It is billed per user, per month, with a discount for annual plans.

Publish lets you turn notes into a website. It is priced per site, per month, and includes custom domains.

A commercial license is required for organizations with two or more people using Obsidian for work.
